report_sentences: In controlled tests, reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch showed no detectable effect, although a few weak, unconfirmed hints appeared in residual regressions.
The evidence suggests that reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch play no role, and I treat them as irrelevant in the submitted law.
- The weak residual hints for stripes, reflectance and temperature (p ≈ 0.05–0.10) were not followed up with dedicated high-sensitivity tests.
irrelevant_property_sentences: In controlled tests, reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch showed no detectable effect, although a few weak, unconfirmed hints appeared in residual regressions.
- hardness (1 vs 10) for each of the three shapes;
- reflectance, stripes and batch together (0/0/1 vs 1/10/50).
- Hardness 1 vs 10 changed C_d by less than 1% for every shape.
- Changing reflectance, stripes and batch together changed C_d by less than 1%.
- stripes on impact speed: p ≈ 0.05, a slope of about −0.07% per stripe (about −0.7% across the full range).
The earlier hardness and radius hints from the 20-run survey regression came from the small sample.
The evidence suggests that reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch play no role, and I treat them as irrelevant in the submitted law.

I am moderately confident that the five decorative properties are irrelevant: controlled tests showed no effect above 1%, but sub-1% effects, and the weak stripes and reflectance hints, cannot be fully excluded.
- The weak residual hints for stripes, reflectance and temperature (p ≈ 0.05–0.10) were not followed up with dedicated high-sensitivity tests.
- Reflectance, stripes and batch were varied together in the controlled test, so their individual effects were not isolated.
